name: Uber
summary: Shows robust fundamentals but faces challenges with weak momentum.

meanings.ret6m: Modest decline over 6 months, underperforming the market.
meanings.ret1y: Weak 1-year performance, lagging the broader market.
meanings.fromHigh: Deep drawdown from peak, significantly below recent highs.
meanings.rsi14: Neutral RSI reading, no extreme buying or selling pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Below all moving averages — downtrend or consolidation.
meanings.macd: MACD negative and falling — bearish momentum.
meanings.vol: High volatility, larger swings than the typical stock.
meanings.beta: In-line with market — moves roughly in step with the S&P 500.

meanings.peVsSector: Trading at a discount to sector peers — relatively cheaper.
